overview: The four-bedroom townhouse example has three occupied levels. Its built-up area is not a plot-size measurement.
A lift, smart-home integration and separate staff accommodation appear in the illustrated villa package. Confirm the specification of the exact home before treating these features as included.
research.locationNote: Academic City, Dubai. Binghatti maps connections to Emirates Road and Dubai–Al Ain Road. Any future Blue Line station remains planned infrastructure, rather than an existing transport service.
research.priceNote: The own project page displays AED 4.2 m as its starting guide. Property Finder marks its developer selection sold out while Binghatti’s page retains an Available flag. Neither establishes an Aliyas allocation or a specific home available at that figure.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% at booking,50% during construction and 40% on handover. No dated primary payment sheet was retrieved from the current linked package; specific instalment dates and any revised offer remain unverified.
research.handoverNote: The retrieved primary material does not establish a handover date. Property Finder’s overall project page now shows December 2029; Bayut’s separately named Tilal Dunes release shows Q1 2029. These forecasts are not interchangeable across releases. Confirm the contracted phase and date directly.
